meta.notes: Top-down DS/PSP entry set in Liberty City in 2009. Adds a drug-trading economy and touchscreen minigames.

items.name: Huang Lee
items.summary: Returns to Liberty City with a stolen sword and a murdered father's legacy to untangle.

items.name: Wu Lee
items.summary: Huang's uncle and the Triad elder he reports to.

items.name: Hsin Jaoming
items.summary: Aging Triad leader whose succession struggle drives the plot.

items.name: Chan Jaoming
items.summary: Hsin's son and one claimant to the Triad leadership.

items.name: Zhou Ming
items.summary: The other claimant to the Triad leadership.

items.name: Rudy D'Avanzo
items.summary: Italian mob contact who pulls Huang into Mafia business.

items.name: Melanie Mallard
items.summary: Investigative journalist working the Triad succession story.

items.name: Wade Heston
items.summary: Undercover operative who recruits Huang's help.

items.name: Lester Leroc
items.summary: Forensics contact who provides Huang with information.

items.name: Ling
items.summary: Huang's ally within the Triad power struggle.

items.name: Yu Jian
items.summary: Go to Kenny's home .
